description: Retry and edit assume a previous context pair without checking that one exists.
trigger: Enter /r or /e immediately after startup, after /clear, or with --amnesia enabled.
expected_behavior: Reject the command gracefully when there is no previous reply.
actual_behavior: Both branches index context[-1] before any guard or exception handler and raise IndexError. --amnesia clears context before command input on every iteration.

verification.description: Inspected context initialization, amnesia clearing, /clear and both new branches in the shared CLI loop.
verification.limits: Reach is the inspected interactive main loop; external callers were not executed.

verification.description: Evaluated the branches' first context access on an empty list; both produced IndexError.
